incidents.text: Mateo Kovacic slides a pass towards Petar Sucic (Croatia) who unleashes a fabulous shot from long range. The ball goes behind the surprised goalkeeper and into the bottom left corner. The score is now 1:0.
Carlos Queiroz has made a change at the break. Kojo Peprah has come on in place of Jonas Adjetey (Ghana).
The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Elisha Owusu (Ghana) comes off for Issahaku Fatawu.
The game has come to an end for Ante Budimir. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Igor Matanovic (Croatia).
Ivan Perisic (Croatia) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
Here is a change. Jordan Ayew is going off and Carlos Queiroz gives the last tactical orders to Brandon Thomas-Asante (Ghana).
Substitution. Kamaldeen Sulemana did his best and is replaced by Ernest Nuamah (Ghana).
A cross from the free kick is whipped deep into the box by Ernest Nuamah and Derrick Luckassen (Ghana) gets in a shot, sending the ball into the bottom right corner. 1:1.
We are about to witness a substitution. Mario Pasalic (Croatia) is replacing Mateo Kovacic.

Goal! Luka Modric sends in a fine cross from the corner kick. The ball finds the head of Nikola Vlasic (Croatia) and his precise header from near the penalty spot ricochets off the post and into the bottom left corner. The score changes to 2:1.
Carlos Queiroz prepares a substitution. Kwasi Sibo is replaced by Caleb Yirenkyi (Ghana).
It's time for a substitution. Marco Pasalic (Croatia) comes on in place of Martin Baturina.
A substitution has been made. Nikola Vlasic goes off and Josko Gvardiol (Croatia) comes on.
What was Kojo Peprah (Ghana) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
